in_sanskrit.name: दिव्यान्शु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who receives divine grace or divine gift. In Hinduism, this name is often given to a child born during auspicious occasions or to a child who is believed to be blessed by the gods.

in_hindi.name: दिव्यांशु

It is believed that the god Indra, the king of the gods, was born as a human in the form of Divyaanshu, and he received divine grace from the gods. This name is also mentioned in various Puranas and Itihasas.
